# hetznerrobot_firewall_template (Data Source)

Reads one firewall template, with its rules, by `id` or by `name` (exactly one of them).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_firewall_template" "base" {
  name = "base"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric template id.
- `name` (String) Name of the template.

### Read-Only

- `filter_ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 traffic is filtered too.
- `input_rules` (Attributes List) Rules for incoming packets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_rules))
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the Robot panel preselects this template.
- `output_rules` (Attributes List) Rules for outgoing packets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--output_rules))
- `whitelist_hos` (Boolean) Whether Hetzner services are always let through.

<a id="nestedatt--input_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `accept` or `discard`.
- `dst_ip` (String) Destination address or subnet.
- `dst_port` (String) Destination port or range.
- `ip_version` (String) `ipv4`, `ipv6`, or null for both.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol above the IP layer.
- `src_ip` (String) Source address or subnet.
- `src_port` (String) Source port or range.
- `tcp_flags` (String) TCP flags.


<a id="nestedatt--output_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `output_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `accept` or `discard`.
- `dst_ip` (String) Destination address or subnet.
- `dst_port` (String) Destination port or range.
- `ip_version` (String) `ipv4`, `ipv6`, or null for both.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol above the IP layer.
- `src_ip` (String) Source address or subnet.
- `src_port` (String) Source port or range.
- `tcp_flags` (String) TCP flags.
